description: Highmark Medicaid case that is fully documented and is denied anyway. The note satisfies every criterion, including four psychopharmacologic trials across two classes with two augmentation trials, and a failed CBT trial with MADRS scores at both ends. The payer denies on hho-03 and hho-04 regardless. This is the appeal demo: the rebuttal quotes the medication table and the therapy dates back at the payer's own policy language.

intake.service: Transcranial magnetic stimulation for major depressive disorder

denial.unmapped_reason_note: The site-of-service reason maps to no criterion in the pack. It must be surfaced in Denial.unmapped_reasons, never silently dropped - a practice needs to know the payer raised something the policy criteria do not cover.
